No class

Buyers stop at the course

Someone can download your guide or buy a course, but nothing shows them what working with you feels like or invites them to go further. The relationship ends at checkout.

No filter

Anyone can book your time

A free call with no application means your diary fills with whoever clicks first, including people who aren’t ready or able to invest yet.

No front door

Too many doors, none built for ads

Your link-in-bio lists more than a dozen options. Ads need one page to send people to, and a new visitor needs one clear next step.

Your courses serve the people ready for something small. Nothing yet turns those buyers, or your 89.4k followers, into coaching clients.

The Gentle No Masterclass

How deep feelers can say a kind, clear no without the guilt spiral

A free 60-minute class with psychotherapist, coach and author Alice Bramhill for the big-hearted people who say yes when they mean no, then replay it for days.

Live on Zoom60 minutesReplay includedFree

Next class starts in

3Days

00Min
00Sec

Sound familiar?

Kindness isn’t the problem. The yes-reflex is.

  • The “yes” comes out before the thought has finished.
  • Saying no feels so loud that it’s easier to just go along with it.
  • After a boundary comes the replay: was that rude, are they upset?
  • You want closeness and you need space, and it feels like you can’t have both.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Five things we’ll cover in 60 minutes

Why “no” can feel so big

Where people-pleasing comes from, and why it’s a pattern you learned, not a flaw in who you are.

Space and closeness, both at once

How to ask for the space you need without pushing away the people you love.

Calming the guilt after a boundary

Simple ways to settle your body and quieten the inner critic when the second-guessing starts.

Words you can actually use

Gentle, clear phrases for family, partners, friends and work, so you’re not starting from a blank page.

Busy seasons and big gatherings

How to plan ahead for the times your energy gets stretched thin, from family visits to the holidays.

Meet Alice

Hi, I’m Alice Bramhill

I’m an interpersonal psychotherapist, coach, author and artist, and I write for the deep feelers and big-hearted people pleasers. More than 89,000 people follow along on Instagram, and over 5,000 read my Substack community.

I’m also a late-diagnosed AuDHD woman, so a lot of what I teach comes from my own life as well as my work. My book is called:

I Need My Space (But I Like You Too!)

This class is a practical, gentle starting point. It’s open to everyone, neurodivergent or neurocurious.

Questions

Before you save your seat

Is this therapy?

No. It’s an educational class with practical tools. It isn’t therapy or medical advice and doesn’t replace working with a professional.

Is it only for neurodivergent people?

No. It’s for anyone who finds boundaries hard, whether you’re neurodivergent, neurocurious or neither.

What if I can’t make it live?

Register anyway. You’ll get the replay, so you can watch when it suits you.

Why is it free?

Because the first step should be easy. Come, try the tools, and decide afterwards if you want to go deeper.

Educational content, not therapy or medical advice.

Script 1 · “The yes-reflex”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Here’s why so many kind people say yes before they’ve even thought about it.”

Body

“For a lot of deep feelers, ‘yes’ became the safe answer a long time ago. It kept the peace. It kept people close. But a yes that should have been a no tends to come back later as exhaustion or resentment. The good news: it’s a pattern, and patterns can be gently unlearned.”

CTA

“I’m teaching how in a free 60-minute live class, the Gentle No Masterclass. Replay included. Tap Sign up to save your seat.”

Shot: talking to camera, warm natural light, on-screen text “the yes-reflex” highlighted in butter yellow. End card: “Educational content, not therapy or medical advice.”

Script 2 · “I need my space”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Needing space doesn’t mean you love people any less.”

Body

“Some of us need quiet to recharge, and closeness to feel safe. Both are real. The trouble is, asking for space can feel like rejecting someone. There are ways to say it that protect your energy and the relationship at the same time.”

CTA

“I’ll share them in my free live masterclass. Sixty minutes, replay included. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: talking to camera, holding a copy of I Need My Space (But I Like You Too!). End card with class name and date.

Script 3 · “The 2am replay”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Ever set a boundary and then replayed it all night?”

Body

“The guilt after a boundary is often louder than the boundary itself. It isn’t proof you did something wrong. It’s your system getting used to something new. In the class I’ll share three simple ways to settle that second-guessing.”

CTA

“It’s free, it’s live, and you can watch the replay. Tap Sign up below.”

Shot: talking to camera, cut to a slide with the 3 ways listed on a sage background.
